rules.sql:
create table AUM_023_024_TMP0
as 
select idno as cust_id,prcs_dt as yyyymmdd,nm,sum(NETQTY/100 *CPRICE * exch_rt) AMT
from 
      (select a.*,
              case when  bond like 'TSSN%' then '複委託結構型商品'
              else '複委託債券' end as NM
      from  DSPBM.PB_BONDPOS_SEC_M@anadbp01_dwdbp01 a ) a
left join 
     ( select A.*
     from dsdep.fn_exch_rt@anadbp01_dwdbp01 a
     inner join 
     ( 
         select substr(prcs_dt,1,6) yyyyymm,max(prcs_dt) prcs_dt 
         from dsdep.fn_exch_rt@anadbp01_dwdbp01 
         group by substr(prcs_dt,1,6)
     ) b on a.prcs_dt=b.prcs_dt
     )b  on a.currency=b.curr_cd and a.yyyymm=substr(b.prcs_dt,1,6)
group by idno,prcs_dt,nm
;

create table AUM_023_024
as 
select * from AUM_023_024_TMP0
union 
select * from AUM_023_024_TMP1;

rules.sql:
create table INCOME_033_034_035_036
as 
select  to_char(to_date(feedate+19110000,'yyyymmdd') ,'yyyymmdd' ) as yyyymmdd --substr(FEEDATE,1,6)  -- FHID,IDNO as cust_id,      
        ,idno as cust_id       
        ,case 
              when FHID not in ('PS','CB','YB','SN') then '基金' 
              when TRIM(FHID) ='YB' then 'ETF'
              when FHID ='PS' then '海外股票'
              when FHID like 'TA%' or FHID  like 'TB%' or FHID  like 'TD%' or FHID  like 'TE%'  then '集合管理帳戶'
        end as   FH_TYP 
        ,baopcccode PCCODE
        ,sum(BrhRebateAmt) as AMT
from DSFND.PB_FUND_SPREAD_DAILY@anadbp01_dwdbp01 
where  (baopcccode like '2E%' or saopcccode like '2E%') and feedate>='011212'  --and feedate='011403' 
group by  
      to_char(to_date(feedate+19110000,'yyyymmdd') ,'yyyymmdd' )   --substr(FEEDATE,1,6),
      ,idno
      ,case 
              when FHID not in ('PS','CB','YB','SN') then '基金' 
              when TRIM(FHID) ='YB' then 'ETF'
              when FHID ='PS' then '海外股票'
              when FHID like 'TA%' or FHID  like 'TB%' or FHID  like 'TD%' or FHID  like 'TE%'  then '集合管理帳戶'
       end
       ,baopcccode;

result.message:
集合管理帳戶的Income來源目前對應銀行手續費類收入，但獨立業務定義尚待確認，並非已正式確認的獨立收入。
集合管理帳戶（income）：集合管理帳戶業務。AUM衡量客戶持有資產；Income的獨立業務定義待確認，不代表已確認計入獨立收入。
每客戶每月總收入：每位客戶每月的手續費類收入與利息收入合計，業務定義尚待正式確認。
